title: Supreme Court Agrees to Review Mandatory Detention Policy Denying Bond Hearings
detail: The Supreme Court agreed to review the Trump administration's policy denying bond hearings to immigrants who have lived in the U.S., deciding whether they have a right to a hearing on continued detention while contesting deportation.

title: DOJ Sues Maryland and Two Counties Over Laws Barring ICE Agent Masks
detail: The Justice Department sued Maryland, Montgomery and Prince George's counties over new laws barring ICE agents from wearing masks, arguing that regulating federal law enforcement violates the Supremacy Clause.

title: Family of Renee Good Files Lawsuit Against Trump Administration Over Fatal ICE Shooting
detail: The family of Renee Good filed a federal lawsuit against the Trump administration and immigration officials over her fatal shooting by ICE agents, seeking accountability for the deadly use of force during an immigration enforcement operation.
